steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter, sugar and brown sugar for 3 minutes, until creamy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla.
Stir in the flour mixture, then the chocolate chips.
Scoop rounded tablespoons of dough onto a baking sheet, two inches apart.
Bake for 9 to 11 minutes, until golden at the edges.
Cool on the sheet for 2 minutes, then move the cookies to a rack.
